items.statement: Submission proposes at least two distinct physical explanations and specifies discriminating calculations before selecting one.
items.expected: Hypotheses are explicit, non-equivalent and linked to observables.

items.statement: Candidate structures/pathways retain identity and per-candidate validation context, with convergence and coverage reported.
items.expected: Open investigation is auditable and bounded by completion or resource stopping criteria.

items.statement: The investigation identifies the 1-ML Pt case as especially favorable for CO lattice-oxygen removal, with a finite barrier and exergonic reaction under the defined convention.
items.expected: A supported conclusion includes values near −1.66 eV and 1.44 eV when that case is completed.

items.statement: A source-supported explanation relates stronger oxide-to-metal charge transfer to Co–O polarization and enhanced 1-ML reactivity, while recognizing weaker dependence for 2 ML.
items.expected: Conclusion distinguishes evidence from speculation and states limitations.
